cameras.description: The BirdDog MAX is a 4K UHD PTZ built on a Sony 1/2.8-inch CMOS with a 12x optical zoom (3.42-40.02mm, F1.88-3.77) and an unusually wide 80.56 degree field of view. BirdDog positions it to bridge the gap between everyday webcams and full production cameras, working as both a USB-C UVC webcam and a networked NDI|HX camera with HDMI out. It adds on-camera AI tracking with auto-framing, motorized pan and tilt and 255 presets, powered by DC 12V or PoE. It suits worship, education, corporate and hybrid meeting rooms.

cameras.autoTrackingNote: Built-in on-camera AI tracking with Presenter Tracking and Zone modes; no external software required.
cameras.description: The BirdDog X4 Ultra is a 4K60 PTZ built around a 1/1.8-inch Sony UHD CMOS and a 20x optical zoom (6.25-125mm, F1.58-3.95) covering a 60 to 3.5 degree horizontal field of view. Fully motorized with 255 presets and built-in AI tracking (Presenter and Zone modes), it carries 3G-SDI, HDMI, USB-C UVC and NDI|HX2/HX3 with RTSP, RTMP and SRT. Uniquely in its class it adds WiFi 6 and an internal battery for up to six hours of untethered operation, and runs on DC 12V, PoE+ or USB-C. It targets flexible multi-camera live production, worship and corporate.

cameras.autoTrackingNote: Built-in on-camera AI tracking with Presenter Tracking and Zone modes; no external software required.
cameras.description: The BirdDog X4E Ultra is the wired-first sibling of the X4 Ultra: the same 1/1.8-inch Sony UHD CMOS, 20x zoom (6.25-125mm, F1.58-3.95), 4K60 capture, built-in AI auto-tracking and identical I/O (3G-SDI, HDMI, USB-C UVC and IP over a single PoE+ cable), but without WiFi 6 or the internal battery. Streaming is via NDI|HX3/HX2, RTSP, RTMP and SRT, with control over VISCA, VISCA over IP and ONVIF. A 360 degree halo tally, 255 presets and an e-ink label round it out. It targets simpler, lower-cost wired multi-camera installs.

fieldNotes.hasND: No built-in ND; the lens carries a 49mm front filter thread for screw-on filters.

cameras.autoTrackingNote: Built-in on-camera AI auto-tracking and framing (Presenter mode); no external software required.
cameras.description: The BirdDog X5 Ultra is a 4K60 PTZ on a 1/2.8-inch Sony UHD CMOS with a 20x optical zoom (5.4-104mm, F1.6-3.6, 56.6 to 3.0 degrees horizontal). Its broad I/O spans 12G-SDI, dual HDMI, USB-C UVC and gigabit network, streaming NDI|HX2/HX3, SRT, RTSP and RTMP, with an integrated NDI|HX decoder for return feeds. Built-in AI auto-tracking, a fast motor drive up to 200 degrees/second, 128 speed-adjustable presets, dual e-ink displays, a halo tally and a 49mm filter thread round it out. Powered by PoE+ or DC 12V, it suits demanding live production and worship.

cameras.autoTrackingNote: Built-in AI presenter tracking and auto-framing, aided by a fixed secondary 100-degree wide-angle camera (a built-in second imager) for full-scene awareness during tracking. The Advanced tracking mode can additionally coordinate with a second camera. No external software required.
cameras.description: The BirdDog XL Ultra is a flagship 4K PTZ on a 4/3-inch Sony 5K CMOS with a 20x zoom (9.8-186mm, F2.8-4.5) and a 71 to 4 degree horizontal field of view. Built for broadcast, virtual production and high-end AV, it has the broadest I/O of the range: 12G-SDI, dual 3G-SDI, HDMI, USB-C and SFP+ fiber, plus High-Bandwidth (full) NDI and NDI|HX2/HX3 with SRT, RTSP and RTMP. It supports FreeD position output for AR and virtual sets, advanced AI tracking, a built-in ND filter and digital stabilization, with control over VISCA, serial VISCA, Pelco-P/D and RS-232/422. It runs on PoE++ or DC 12V.

cameras.autoTrackingNote: Built-in on-camera AI tracking engine with adjustable motion profiles; no external software required.
cameras.description: The BirdDog O4 is an outdoor 4K60 PTZ on a Sony 1/1.8-inch UHD CMOS with a 30x optical zoom (6.9-215mm; 60x in HD mode) in an IP66 die-cast aluminium body rated -40 to +60 Celsius with an integrated heater. It streams High-Bandwidth NDI plus NDI|HX2/HX3 and SRT, RTMP and RTSP, with native 12G-SDI and SFP fiber output and PoE++ power. A built-in AI tracking engine follows subjects, and a 500m IR laser with IR-cut filter enables total-darkness capture. FreeD position data (over UDP and embedded in NDI) supports AR and virtual-set workflows, with control over VISCA over IP, Pelco and RS-232/422.
